problems.problem: The agent violated the instruction to 'exhaustively check all options to find the exact entity that fulfills the next hop'. When identifying the establishment adjacent to the Dunes Hotel, the agent stopped at the Golden Nugget Hotel & Casino and completely failed to evaluate the Sahara Boardwalk Hotel and Casino, which was explicitly mentioned in passage [7] as being located between the Golden Nugget and the Dunes (and thus also adjacent to the Dunes).
